rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice when an action keeps happening, often with an annoyed tone.

example.english: You repeatedly forget to bring your keys.
example.jyutping: nei5 seng4 jat6 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4

rows.note: Use this for explicitly saying that someone has done something repeatedly, especially in a firm or formal context.

example.english: The company repeatedly reminded employees to arrive at work on time.
example.traditional: 公司一再提醒員工要準時返工。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 jat1 zoi3 tai4 sing2 jyun4 gung1 jiu3 zeon2 si4 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this when you want to emphasize that the same event happened again and again.

example.english: They apologized repeatedly in front of me.
example.traditional: 佢一次又一次喺我面前道歉。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 ci3 jau6 jat1 ci3 hai2 ngo5 min6 cin4 dou6 hip3

rows.note: Use this when the repetition continues without stopping or with very short pauses.

example.english: The kid repeatedly cried without stopping, so I couldn't sleep.
example.traditional: 個細路不停咁喊，搞到我瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: go3 sai3 lou6 bat1 ting4 gam3 haam3 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek6
